Ask Franklin

Ask Franklin. Get a local answer.

Ask about local businesses, city services, permits, schools, events, transportation, community resources, or everyday tasks in Franklin.

What you can expect

  • A direct answer to your question
  • Local information when it is available
  • Helpful links when they make the answer more useful
  • No account required
Ask a question

What can I help you with?

Type your question the way you would ask a neighbor who knows Franklin.

Please do not include passwords, Social Security numbers, account numbers, or other highly sensitive information. For an emergency, call 911. For suicide or mental-health crisis support, call or text 988. Privacy

How Ask Franklin helps

1

Ask naturally

Use everyday language. You do not need to know which department, directory category, or local resource to start with.

2

Get a direct answer

Franklin gives you the useful part first, then adds local details or links when they help.

3

Keep going

Ask a follow-up question if you need more detail, another option, or a clearer next step.

When information can changeFranklin checks current public information when possible. If something important cannot be confirmed, the answer should tell you that rather than guess.
